components.name: Primary Observatory Action
components.description: Main action for entering the 3D dome or archiving a memory.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7cdee4; color: #03045e; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cdee4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Secondary action paired beside primary observatory CTAs.

narrative.overview: Twelve Skies pairs the deep-space Neowise starfield backdrop with pointer-reactive bioluminescent cyan star wakes so the night sky remains an active, breathable ground across every route. UI surfaces step back into disciplined midnight-abyss containers ruled by razor-thin cyan hairlines, allowing 4-point sparkle stars, twelve calibrated zodiac hues, and personal photography to lead without visual competition.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous Neowise cosmic starfield (#000000 to #04091e) augmented by a 60fps pointer-reactive wake canvas (#7cdee4 / #38bdf8).
Geometric Titillium Web display headings paired with Manrope body prose and JetBrains Mono reserved strictly for astronomical coordinates, dates, and distribution formulas.
Restraint in frosted glass (backdrop-blur-md capped to focused inspection lenses, modals, and the split-view memory journal).
Twelve spectral constellation colors reserved for astronomical geometry, glyphs, and node beacons.

rules.name: The Chromatic Sky Rule
rules.body: Never apply gradient fills to display text or flood sections with decorative cyan glow. Electric cyan marks interactive intent; constellation spectral hues mark astronomical houses only.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never stack tracked uppercase mono pills above display headlines; let heading scale and hierarchy speak directly.

rules.name: The Starfield Depth Rule
rules.body: Never seal panels with opaque muddy greys or large radial glow blobs that block the Neowise cosmic starfield.

dos: Do use custom vector glyphs (ZodiacGlyph.tsx and CelestialLogo.tsx) for all astronomical iconography.
Do mark every public sample memory entry clearly as Illustrative Preview or Illustrative Sample Entries.
Do provide explicit loading, error-with-retry, and empty states plus Escape key handling on all interactive panels and modals.
Do keep prefers-reduced-motion: reduce respected across wake canvas animations, panel slides, and smooth scrolling.
donts: Don't render raw Unicode zodiac emojis (♌, ✨) or em dashes (—) anywhere in UI copy.
Don't use pill (rounded-[30px]) inputs or stack backdrop-blur across every landing section card.
Don't invent metrics, testimonials, or unlabelled sample claims.
